verdict.rationale: Trello's own REST API supports API keys plus user tokens that can 'read and write for your entire Trello account,' with configurable token lifetime and scope, and exposes batch, search and webhook endpoints. That lets scripts and CI jobs drive Trello without the UI. There is no documented headless CLI, CI integration guide, or service-account flow, so delivery rests on raw API use. missing for 10: an official CLI or headless runner, CI-specific documentation or examples, non-user service credentials, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: This token, along with your API key, can be used to read and write for your entire Trello account.
navigate to the Trello Auth tab and select the option Generate a new API Key.
The length of access and scope of permissions are all configurable via query params
